sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural decline; copper and gold counter-cyclical strength. Flagship ups copper; WA gold juniors active. Iron ore 'drowning' signals prolonged BHP/RIO/FMG pressure.
sectors.implications: Rotate out of iron ore exposure; favour gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and copper (STO.AX, FMG.AX copper division). WA gold juniors (AUR.AX, GDR.AX, FRT.AX, GWP.AX) offer speculative upside.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as oil-driven rate hike fears hit equity valuations. RBA tightening cycle perceived as recessionary. Qantas $35m payout signals credit stress in transport.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression risk if recession materialises. Defensive yield still attractive but capital preservation risk rising.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran conflict; Santos gas cartel narrative; AI data centres straining power supply. NSW power shortfall risk. Coal-to-data-centre pivot by power giants.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, AWE.AX benefit from gas/oil spike. Power generators (AGL.AX, GPT.AX, ORG.AX) face demand surge but transition disruption. FLEX $4.4b AI power bet signals structural demand.

sectors.trend: Home buyer sentiment collapses; 102-year-old retailer closes 25 stores; business conditions weakest since pandemic. Consumer confidence deteriorating sharply.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) under pressure from weak footfall and rising rates. WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin squeeze. Avoid cyclical consumer names.

sectors.trend: AI data centre build-out driving power demand; FLEX $4.4b bet; Anthropic AI existential risk debate. Employers paying premium for 'human' skills as AI displaces roles.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed data centre and power infrastructure plays benefit. CSL.AX, SXW.AX (tech) see mixed signals. AI risk narrative could trigger volatility.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure: oil at US$100, RBA rate hike fears, iron ore weakness, and collapsing consumer sentiment create a risk-off environment. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports. Banks and materials lead declines. Gold and energy provide relative strength.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift underway: iron ore decline, AI-driven power demand, and housing correction reshape sector leadership. Gold, copper, and energy infrastructure emerge as multi-year themes. RBA policy pivot likely within 2–3 quarters if recession confirms.
